newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan premium has fallen greatly since Dec -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan premium has fallen greatly since Dec -- MOF.

text.p: The Japan premium -- the extra cost to Japanese banks of raising funds in the Euro interbank market -- has fallen greatly after a rise in December caused by seasonal factors, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, said on Monday.
Sakakibara said the Japan premium for three-month Eurodollars had risen as high as 0.21 percentage points in December due to seasonal factors.
"But as of Friday, it had fallen greatly, standing at around 0.11 percentage point," he said.
